data.fund_type: An open ended scheme replicating / tracking S&P BSE Sensex Index
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide returns that, before expenses, closely correspond to the total returns ofthe securities as represented by the underlying index, subject to tracking error. However there is no guarantee or assurancethat the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
